answer: A copper-stamped garden deed keeps fakes out. First, each newcomer stakes 150 POA for a copper deed token tied to one hardware key. Second, the newcomer tends a small garden plot for 14 days, each verified task weaving one thread into the deed under a mentor's watch. Third, mentors audit the plot: a failed audit burns the stake and shreds the deed for 120 days. Forging 1,000 deeds would cost 150,000 POA, 60,000 dollars in copper tokens, and 14,000 days of tended work. Like a community garden that trusts only hands it has watched water the beds, the commons stays open to the honest.
